pattern_notes: No review dates visible in snippets, so no recency trend can be claimed. Costco's native rating (4.0/984) runs below the 4.2-4.4 seen on the big syndicated pools. A Best Buy Q&A title 'Installed new GUD27ESSM1WW 4 days ago...' and a PartSelect 'Noisy' symptom page corroborate noise/early-failure themes.
syndication_observation: No explicit 'originally posted on...' text observed (targeted search returned nothing). However, counts strongly suggest a shared/syndicated pool: Home Depot ~13.0k @4.2 and Lowe's item 1000374215 = 12,668 @4.2 nearly identical, Walmart ~9.7-10k @4.3 same order of magnitude, while Best Buy (~1.3k) and Costco (984) hold much smaller, likely native pools. Review-count drift across snippets reflects different crawl dates.
